title: About
text:
Gnoll Pack Analytics, LLC is run by its owner/operator John M. A. Wojahn, PhD FLS, (aka Michael) an evolutionary plant biologist who graduated in Winter 2025 from Boise State University with a Doctor of Philosophy in Evolution, Ecology, and Behavior - Global Change Emphasis.
Michael has authored several publications, as well as inventing the G2PMineR R package for the NSF EPSCoR GEM3 project, an automated literature review approach, which has been cited in numerous publications.
What is a gnoll? A gnoll is a fantasy creature from the role-playing game Dungeons and Dragons resembling an anthropomorphic hyena.

title: About
text:
Services
We offer an array of bioinformatics services, from simple statistical analysis to more detailed genomic assembly and analyses pipelines. Please visit our pricing page to see rates.

title: Pricing
text: Our pricing structure depends on the difficulty of the project, whether it involves mentoring as well as consulting, and the expected turnaround time. There is a discount for members of the Biology Department at BSU.

title: Welcome!
text:
At Gnoll Pack Analytics, we strive to provide our customers with the best bioinformatics consulting experience possible.
We offer a range of services, from a basic consulting session to full-service pipeline development and execution.
Our prices are competitive: with less overhead we offer lower prices than comparable institutional services without sacrificing quality.
Schedule a FREE, ten minute consultation to join the Gnoll Pack and begin your bioinformatics journey today!
